steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a recurring calendar event titled 'Catch up on Annual Report' starting on 2023-10-24 at 19h. The event recurs daily, forever, and lasts for 15 minutes each occurrence. The event description should be 'We will prepare for upcoming project milestones. Looking forward to productive discussions.'.
